description: Tamarack Bank, a Canadian bank advertising its cashback credit card

claim_types.approval: anything about being approved, accepted or qualifying ("guaranteed approval", "everyone qualifies")
claim_types.intro_rate: a promotional or introductory interest rate, with or without its duration
claim_types.rewards_bonus: a welcome bonus, cash back or rewards amount
claim_types.annual_fee: any statement about the annual fee, including "no annual fee"
claim_types.superlative: best, lowest, number one, favourite, or a comparison with other cards or banks
claim_types.testimonial: a named or quoted customer, or an endorsement by a person
